Cross-validation scenario: substitutes the office-EMB professional fee with the Ladabaum et al. 2011 $224 (2010 dollars) literature anchor, inflated to 2026 dollars via the real BLS CPI-U Medical Care series (~$342). Tests whether the base-case conclusion is sensitive to using an independent historical cost track instead of the CMS-2026 fee-schedule figure.
